_comment: SAMPLE mapping for the OpenMRS 3 reference-application demo database ONLY.
It demonstrates automated capture end to end; it is NOT a validated EMT MDS case-definition set.
The demo database holds randomly generated CIEL diagnoses, so groupings here are illustrative.
Before any real deployment, replace these with definitions agreed with the clinical team and
re-set 'reviewed' deliberately. Rows left out stay 'Not configured' rather than counting zero.

o._note: MDS o - new consultations. Demo proxy: Visit Note encounters. In a real deployment this must use an encounter type that distinguishes NEW consultations from follow-ups.

40._note: MDS 40 / summary item p - new admissions. Admission encounter type.

4._note: MDS 4 - major head / spine injury. Intracranial injury, spinal cord injury and vertebral fracture.

10._note: MDS 10 - acute watery diarrhea. Non-bloody diarrhea entries in the demo dictionary.

3._note: MDS 3 - female, pregnant. Pregnancy status = Yes. The demo database currently holds no such observation, so this row counts 0 and must not be read as 'no pregnant patients'. Included to show the codedObservation shape alongside the others.
3.question: 5272AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA

42._note: MDS 42 - death within facility. Demo proxy only: no discharge-disposition concept is populated in this database, so Discharge encounters are NOT a valid death mapping. Left unmapped on purpose - see README.
